license: Scientific facts transcribed with attribution. PHC figures: CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted; source artwork provenance must be verified separately. Richardson article: CC BY-NC 4.0. No exclusive ownership or endorsement claimed.
methodologyNotes: Original Fig. 1 uses logarithmic wedge lengths and explicitly excepts freshwater from the common-radius normalization. This adaptation instead exposes a project reference-relative ratio and keeps the existing linear radius for every channel. It does not reproduce Fig. 1 distances. Table 1 is authoritative for this snapshot: forcing 2.91, ocean 2.8, ozone 284.6; later retrospective columns differ. HANPP reference 1.9 is reported NPP variability, not an observed human-appropriation baseline. Ocean high-risk column is ambiguous in the original table; left unavailable rather than copied from a later report.
normalizationNote: Project reference-relative-v1: q=(observed-reference)/(boundary-reference). Lower-is-worse variables use negative denominator; no universal observed/boundary division. Not an official risk severity score. Published boundary comparators and uncertainties remain explicit.
displayTransformation: pb-high-risk-aligned-v1: q=(observed-reference)/(PB-reference); h=(highRisk-reference)/(PB-reference). Display d=q for q<=1; d=1+(q-1)/(h-1) for q>1 when h is known. PB radius=green radius; high-risk radius=2*green radius is a visual choice, not q=2. Unknown high-risk thresholds fall back to linear q with explicit unknown status. Only display radius is capped. Manual illustration retains the legacy linear controller.

indicators.label: Genetic diversity
indicators.definition: Extinctions per million species-years. Boundary anchor 10 represents the published <10 precautionary threshold.

indicators.uncertainty: Wide extinction-rate uncertainty; retain the published range or one-sided estimate, never an exact midpoint.

indicators.label: Green water disturbance
indicators.definition: Ice-free land area with root-zone soil moisture deviations outside preindustrial variability; captures wet and dry disturbance.

source.name: Richardson et al. (2023), Science Advances
source.locator: Table 1, pp. 5–6; Fig. 1 and freshwater section

indicators.uncertainty: Hydrological model-based land-area disturbance, not water withdrawal. Preindustrial variability and model/reference revision affect comparisons; 50% high-risk is provisional.

indicators.label: Ocean aragonite saturation
indicators.definition: Global mean surface seawater saturation state with respect to aragonite (Ω); declining values indicate greater acidification.

source.name: Richardson et al. (2023), Science Advances
source.locator: Table 1, pp. 5–6; Fig. 1 and freshwater section

indicators.uncertainty: Lower saturation means greater acidification. Reference/boundary revised in 2025; high-risk threshold provisional. Original 2023 table ambiguity is not resolved with a later value.
